description: Democratic Sen. Chris Van Hollen of Maryland said Thursday that he will run for Senate majority leader in the next Congress, setting up a challenge to Democratic Leader Chuck Schumer after the party swept to power in the midterm elections.
title: Maryland's Van Hollen to challenge Schumer for Senate leadership post

author: Sophia Laporte
description: Indigenous leaders from across Canada gathered in Ottawa on Thursday to say Prime Minister Mark Carney’s new budget leaves Indigenous women out of the decisions made in the more than 500-page document.
title: Indigenous women leaders say budget doesn't address their realities

author: Christine Pagulayan
description: U.S. actor Christina Applegate is questioning whether her breast implants could be contributing to her pain and fatigue. Experts say symptoms associated with breast implant illness can overlap with other conditions, so people experiencing them should seek a thorough medical evaluation before making decisions about their implants.
title: Christina Applegate asks if breast implants are behind symptoms after MS misdiagnosis

description: In a Thursday update, EducationPlannerBC says that, on Nov. 3, it identified a "cybersecurity incident affecting its application system."
title: B.C. post-secondary application portal affected by data breach

author: Mrinalika Roy
description: Pfizer will no longer sell its hormone replacement therapy Premarin in Canada following an internal review. The product has been available as a vaginal cream and three strengths of oral tablets.
title: Pfizer ends sale of hormone therapy cream Premarin in Canada

description: A widespread outage hit Microsoft platforms including Outlook on Thursday, with many users encountering trouble using their email accounts and other errors across the tech giant's suite of apps.
title: Widespread outages reported across Microsoft apps

author: Philip Drost
description: If you missed the chance to see Star Wars in the theatre in 1977 — or weren't yet born — you'll get another chance on Feb. 19, when Disney re-releases both the original film and a 70-millimetre Imax version to mark its 50th anniversary.
title: Original Star Wars returning to theatres for 50th anniversary

author: Dylan Robertson
description: Prime Minister Mark Carney heard from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Thursday about the state of negotiations with Russia as the two discussed continental security with European leaders.
title: Carney wraps meetings on security, trade with European leaders in Ireland

description: Russian hockey federation president Vladislav Tretiak is threatening to seek compensation from Canada and push for the relocation or cancellation of next month's world junior championship in Alberta if Russia is barred from competing.
title: Russian federation head Tretiak says it will seek compensation if barred from world juniors in Alberta

author: Jillian Kestler-D'Amours
description: Travel from Canada to the U.S. dropped amid President Donald Trump's threats and trade war. While many Canadians view the Democratic Party's midterm election victory as an 'encouraging' sign, they say it's too soon to visit the U.S. again amid continued distrust.
title: Will U.S. travel pick up after midterm 'blue wave'? Not so fast, say these Canadians

author: Maddie Ryan
description: Emergency vehicles rushed to a PAL aircraft that landed at the St. John's International Airport around 4:10 p.m. NT.
title: Plane with mechanical problems makes 'successful' landing at St. John's International Airport

description: U.S. War Secretary Pete Hegseth has given a top award to the service member who scolded him and his staff at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier following a Veterans Day ceremony at Arlington National Cemetery.
title: U.S. army guard given medal by Hegseth day after Tomb of the Unknown Soldier reprimand

author: Jacqueline Newsome
description: The students were allegedly placed in a metal locker as a disciplinary measure. The Education Ministry is in touch with the investigating authorities to better understand what took place.
title: Report of children confined in locker at Quebec school draws minister's condemnation

description: In forming its broadcast team for the return of Hockey Night in Canada with Professional Women’s Hockey League coverage, CBC Sports has turned to broadcasters, journalists, and former players.
title: CBC announces Hockey Night in Canada broadcast team for PWHL season

description: Middle-aged men should undergo regular screening for prostate cancer, the American Cancer Society said Thursday in a major change to U.S. guidelines. It comes a month after the Canadian Cancer Society urged a new national advisory body to update its prostate cancer guidelines.
title: The U.S. is now urging middle-aged men to routinely screen for prostate cancer. What about Canada?

description: The CEO of the National Capital Commission (NCC) says the Crown corporation is seriously mulling artificially freezing the northern end of the Rideau Canal to make skating conditions more reliable in the winter.
title: NCC mulling refrigerating downtown end of Rideau Canal

description: U.S. President Donald Trump's envoys met with President Vladimir Putin on Thursday as Washington sought new momentum in peace efforts after two days of U.S.-mediated negotiations between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
title: U.S. envoys Kushner, Witkoff meet with Putin at Kremlin in talks to end Russia-Ukraine war

description: Shelter-in-place advisories have been issued in the Pemberton Valley and parts of the District of Squamish as flooding threatens local properties and roads. Líl̓wat Nation expanded an evacuation order for its community Thursday morning.
title: Shelter-in-place advisory issued for B.C.'s Pemberton Valley, parts of Squamish as flooding closes roads

description: Rapper Yella Beezy was found guilty on Wednesday of hiring the gunman who fatally shot rapper MO3 in a brazen daylight attack on a busy Dallas interstate in 2020.
title: Yella Beezy found guilty in murder-for-hire of fellow Dallas rapper

author: Emily Fagan
description: Even as Yin Yeung Derek Chan went to prison earlier this year, the actions of Canada's most prolific voyeur continued to "irrevocably scar" the lives of victims, a judge said. Chan had uploaded many of the "countless" videos and images secretly recorded of at least 652 women and children online.
title: Anti-child porn group fights to remove 'countless' online images from Canada's most prolific voyeur

author: Isabel Ruitenbeek
description: Inmates at Whitehorse Correctional Centre faced unscheduled lockdowns almost every second day this year, adding up to hundreds of additional hours confined to their cells. Lawyers say that affects mental health, access to programming and court proceedings.
title: Lockdowns are happening at Whitehorse jail for wrong reasons, advocates say

author: Kyle Bakx
description: Canada’s only liquified natural gas facility began operating last year, yet the country has an opportunity to scale up that industry and become one of the top natural gas exporters in the world, according to a new report.
title: Canada has the opportunity to become a global LNG leader, new report says

author: Carolyn Ray
description: CBC News has learned that several Halifax-area hospitals have been dealing with soaring costs to deal with mice and pigeon infestations. Nova Scotia Health says it could take years to rid its facilities of the mice issue.
title: Halifax-area hospitals see pest control budgets soar amid mice, pigeon infestations

author: Alex Flood
description: The Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry says strong predation numbers of wolves and black bears could be a major factor in moose decline while a conservationist says rising temperatures are putting stress on the large mammals.
title: Ontario's moose population is in decline, and the province is trying to figure out why

description: The Constitutional Court and the Supreme Court ruled last month that the documents Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted regarding his overseas education didn't meet election requirements.
title: Indonesia's vice-president resigns after academic credentials questioned

description: A 17-year-old boy with autism was found alive Thursday after six days lost in eastern Australian woodlands.
title: Missing teen found alive after 6 days in the Australian woodlands

description: An Israeli airstrike targeting the Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza killed six people and wounded at least a dozen more, Gaza's Health Ministry said.
title: Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital kills 6 people, health authorities say

author: Geoff Nixon
description: The U.S. airline has begun flying into northern Haiti on a daily basis, providing a vital route into the country at a time when Americans have few options to get there as the U.S. government advises people to avoid all travel to the Caribbean nation due to security conc
title: American Airlines resumes flights to Haiti, providing a vital route into the country

author: Jeff Lagerquist
description: American AI giant Anthropic's expected debut on the Nasdaq has one money manager recalling the dot-com bubble of the 2000s.
title: Anthropic IPO to test the first 'pure play' AI stock in a choppy market

author: Anna Lyhina
description: When Anna Lyhina moved from Ukraine to Quebec, she realized immigration can produce its own form of silence — not because anyone forbade her to speak. Learning a new language was about becoming herself again.
title: I studied silence in Ukraine, but moving to Montreal made me truly understand it

author: Eric Szeto, Courteney Dorrington, Jordan Pearson, Ivan Angelovski
description: More than 1,500 misleading job postings on LinkedIn and Monster were actually connected to a multi-level marketing company, a CBC News visual investigation has found.
title: LinkedIn, Monster take down over 1,000 fake job postings after CBC investigation

author: Benjamin Shingler, Douglas Gelevan
description: A severe stomach bug has spread through Montreal's homeless population, raising concern among shelter workers who say not enough is being done to contain it.
title: Shelter workers raise alarm as severe stomach bug hits Montreal's homeless population
